_doc: Find Me Money's Revenue OS settings: which of the nine agents exist, where each starts from in this pack, and what each waits on. Names of things only. The bot reads this with REVENUE-OS.md, which is the build list. Check it with python3 tools/check_campaign.py campaign.json.

grok.account: a Find Me Money account, never AI Guy's

offer: Funding for people and businesses who need it: kept in-house or passed to one partner for a percentage
icp: People and businesses asking for funding; wholesalers; local businesses; the funding community as partners

crm.name: GoHighLevel (Pinnacle Funding Group)
live_writers: the funding CRM manager (a Hermes profile on the Mac)
the reply agent on the Mac (files every lead it drafts for)
the site's application form (through the Lending Hub)
crm.note: The bot's sales agent drafts and logs only while context/owners.md says pinnacle-ghl: live. It becomes the one writer when the owner pauses the live writers and says 'pinnacle-ghl: bot' and 'crm-writes: on'.

sending.cold_email: Instantly (the existing domains, or new ones: the owner's call)

engines.note: The owner, 2026-11-18: give the Revenue OS to GrokBot and have it build it. The CLIs run on the bot's computer through engines/route.py. The Mac's Hermes profile stays the executor for browser lanes and the high-frequency sweeps (TRIGGER-MAP.md).

dream-100.source: agents/dream-100/, settings/dream-100.json; role partners; data/lists/ (influencers, coaches, communities, partner-targets)
dream-100.waits_on: nothing to build the list from the rubric and draft; a first touch going out waits on the owner's yes per draft

dream-500.waits_on: nothing to build and place the list; sending waits on a sending tool and inboxes (the domain decision)

partners.waits_on: one active partner and the split; a sending tool and inboxes for volume email

cold-email.waits_on: the domain decision; the owner's charter (who, how, what a first line may say)

lead-radar.source: the Funding Lead Radar (live, its own service); roles/radar.md; agents/lead-radar/, settings/lead-radar.json
lead-radar.waits_on: nothing to judge its finds on Codex and hand them to the sales agent through the log

content.source: roles/content.md, skills/content/fmm-viral-content (the eight hooks); agents/content/, settings/content.json
content.waits_on: a brand account per outlet and who publishes on each; the owner's content setup; any video tool is spend

speaker.waits_on: the owner's speaker profile for funding (topics, approved claims, proof) and whether funding wants shows

aeo-seo.source: the site (guide hub, answer pages, schema, sitemap, llms.txt; baseline: cited on 0 of 15 questions); agents/aeo-seo/, settings/aeo-seo.json
aeo-seo.waits_on: Search Console and Bing verification; the tracking tool's key and the owner's yes to its cost; site changes go to the site's own repo as a pull request

sales-crm.source: roles/sales.md, skills/sales/, engine/pinnacle-reply-agent, engine/fcm; agents/sales-crm/, settings/sales-crm.json
sales-crm.waits_on: Codex signed in on the bot's computer; the owner naming which live agent on the Mac is the base and pausing the other before the bot writes the CRM or answers
sales-crm.combined: One agent (the owner, 2026-11-17). Two live agents on the Mac do these jobs today; the bot's stays on test (drafts and the log) until the owner switches them.

reply_rules: no link and no 'DM me' or 'call me' in any public reply (a checker enforces it)
a first reply asks for nothing
Facebook is answered by hired posters (Justin, 2026-11-07) unless he reverses
lanes_note: The pack's own lanes outside the nine stay as they are: wholesale and loan-officer (roles/), and the worker's lanes on the Mac.
cutover: A find-me-money Hermes profile on the Mac is meant to replace the older funding profiles. The Revenue OS sales agent is that cutover, not one more copy: NEEDS-JUSTIN.md, Track C.
